text: {"lessons":["Selling Stocks B and C after gains felt rewarding, but a gain versus my cost is not by itself a reason to sell; I should focus on each holding’s future prospects and portfolio role.","I sold Stock A for a small gain, then held through declines. I should judge positions by their expected risk and return, not by whether they are above or below my purchase price.","After several down periods, I bought more of every stock, but past declines do not predict a rebound. I should use a planned allocation and risk limits rather than react to recent price moves."]}
